subject.title: Feature request: config option to suppress sub-agent announce

question: Should OpenClaw expose a public completion-delivery policy that can suppress only the external user-facing update while retaining the internal parent completion event?
rationale: Current main already resolves the original raw-child-output safety concern through parent-session events, but a deterministic mute guarantee would add a new tool/config contract and could unintentionally disable orchestration if it suppresses the wrong layer.

options.title: Keep parent-gated defaults only
options.body: Treat the current parent-session event flow as the intended solution and close the remaining request for a separate suppression option.

options.title: Add a narrow per-spawn policy
options.body: Add an explicit public per-spawn completion-delivery mode that retains the internal event but prevents external user delivery, with documented defaults and regression coverage.

options.title: Design a persistent default policy
options.body: Also add a sub-agent default only if maintainers want administrators to impose this behavior across all spawns and accept the added config surface.

recommendation.title: Add a narrow per-spawn policy
recommendation.body: Add an explicit public per-spawn completion-delivery mode that retains the internal event but prevents external user delivery, with documented defaults and regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent merged history connects this person to the central sessions-spawn and sub-agent completion-routing design.
